description: This file implements an idleness management component for gRPC connections, handling entering and exiting idle mode based on RPC activity, with timers and concurrency control.

classes.name: ClientConn
classes.description: Interface defining methods to control idle mode for a gRPC client connection.

classes.name: Manager
classes.description: Struct managing connection idleness, timers, and state transitions based on RPC activity.

methods.name: NewManager
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Manager instance with specified idle timeout.

methods.name: resetIdleTimerLocked
methods.description: Resets the internal idle timer to a specified duration, called within lock.

methods.name: resetIdleTimer
methods.description: Locks and calls resetIdleTimerLocked to reset the timer.

methods.name: handleIdleTimeout
methods.description: Callback invoked when idle timer expires; attempts to transition to idle if no activity.

methods.name: tryEnterIdleMode
methods.description: Attempts to put the connection into idle mode, checking for recent activity.

methods.name: EnterIdleModeForTesting
methods.description: Forcibly triggers idle mode for testing purposes.

methods.name: OnCallBegin
methods.description: Marks the start of an RPC, potentially exiting idle mode.

methods.name: ExitIdleMode
methods.description: Exits idle mode, calling the underlying connection method and resetting timers.

methods.name: UnsafeSetNotIdle
methods.description: Internal method to forcibly mark the connection as not idle.

methods.name: OnCallEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of an RPC, updating last call end time.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the Manager has been closed.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Stops timers and marks the Manager as closed.
